title: Tenant dashboards blank during high-traffic bursts due to metric-shard eviction
creator: Priya Desai
description: Multiple customers reported blank/empty tenant dashboards and missing recent metrics during peak traffic windows. Investigation shows that the metric-index eviction heuristics were prematurely purging active shard segments for high-throughput tenants. When the livepanel aggregation job attempted to read the recently-written windows, queries fell back to an index path that returned no rows, causing dashboard tiles to show "no data" instead of degraded values. This impacted Hosted and Dedicated customers using per-tenant ingestion windows and exacerbated trace stitching gaps for recent spans.
impact_scope: Affected tenants see sparse or empty dashboard tiles for 1-7 minute windows during sustained bursts; alerts may fire and then resolve when shards are rehydrated. Frequency: observed in 7 customers (3 enterprise) during two incidents in Feb-March. Reproducible in staging with synthetic traffic replay.
root_cause_summary: Adaptive shard eviction TTL underestimated activity for tenants with bursty ingestion patterns. The eviction decision used a sampling window that ignored short high-rate bursts; combined with an index compaction path that rewrites segment offsets, recent segments were evicted and later compacted away before being rehydrated by the streaming reindexer.
mitigation_actions: 2026-02-21: Rolled out emergency kill-switch to disable adaptive eviction for flagged enterprise tenants (feature flag: obs.eviction.disable_for_enterprise)
2026-02-22: Increased default eviction grace window from 120s to 420s in production to reduce noisy evictions
2026-02-25: Triggered targeted rehydrate job for impacted tenant shards (backfill completed for 7 tenants)
planned_work: Add per-tenant burst-awareness to eviction algorithm: use sliding-window peak-rate metrics rather than global average
Introduce a lightweight hot-segment mark to prevent compaction of recently-written segments used by livepanels and trace-stitcher
Improve instrumentation: per-tenant eviction audit logs, dashboard tile-level error codes (null vs degraded) and an alert action that auto-triggers rehydrate
Add e2e test in staging that replays 10m burst traffic and asserts livepanel continuity
resolution_notes: Hotfix sequence: feature-flag disable -> extended grace window -> targeted rehydrate. Immediate customer-facing impact reduced to near-zero within 12 minutes for most tenants after the kill-switch. Current in-progress work focuses on algorithmic changes and additional telemetry. Postmortem will include SLA credit assessment for impacted customers and a plan for a coordinated Dedicated customer rollout.
